# annotated object creation type

new @TypeUse String();

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(
    ObjectCreationExpression(
      new,
      MarkerAnnotation(Identifier),
      TypeName,
      ArgumentList)))

# annotated array creation type

new @TypeUse String[1];

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(
    ArrayCreationExpression(
      new,
      MarkerAnnotation(Identifier),
      TypeName,
      Dimension(IntegerLiteral))))
